title: {Syn} AlexNet Announced the GPU Deep Learning Era
content:
AlexNet won the 2012 ImageNet competition by a large margin using a deep convolutional neural network trained on GPUs.

It helped convince the machine-learning community that scale, learned visual features, and accelerator hardware could outperform carefully hand-engineered pipelines.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
